findings.title: Test imports "./index.ts" but tsconfig does not allow .ts import extensions
findings.why: tsconfig.json includes `src` (so the test file is type-checked) with `module: NodeNext`, and it does not set `allowImportingTsExtensions` or `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions`. TypeScript rejects `import ... from "./index.ts"` under those settings with error TS5097. That would fail the type check, and a `tsc` build that includes the test file with it. I checked by reading the tsconfig and the import line; I did not run `tsc`.
